scores.notes: Compared sky, lighting and shoreline. Left is in bright daylight under a pale sky with the town far off at the end of the path. Right is under dark storm clouds at night, with a town on a cliff right beside the shore, so day versus night conflicts.

Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with the crucified figure (right, top centre). Both have the same icon face, centre-parted shoulder-length brown hair, a short brown beard, the same skin tone and a halo.
Left Jesus, standing on the water, has long dark hair and a beard. On the right the crucified figure is only a few pixels tall on a distant cross, so the face cannot be judged.
Compared the crucified Jesus (left, top) with the distant Jesus on the waves (right). Both have long dark-brown hair, a short dark beard, a slim face and a cream tunic with a blue mantle.

Both are at night under dark storm clouds, with rough teal water and a sandy, rocky sea floor or shore. The right shows the shore before the parting, seen from a different viewpoint, and nothing in the land, water or sky conflicts.

Left Jesus at the tomb has long brown hair and a full beard. The crucified figure on the right is tiny on a distant cross, with only dark hair and a dark beard visible, so the face cannot be compared.
Compared the distant Jesus on the water (left) with Jesus at the tomb (right). Both have long dark-brown hair, a full dark beard, a slim face and the same skin tone.

Compared the head of Moses with the staff on the shore (left) and the Moses beside Aaron (right). Both are elderly with long white beards, but left has long flowing white hair over the crown while right has a clearly bald dome with hair only at the sides.
The crucified figure on the left is a tiny distant figure whose face cannot be made out. Right Jesus at the tomb has long brown hair and a beard, so identity cannot be compared.
Compared Peter leaping (left) with Peter stepping from the boat (right). Both have short curly dark-grey hair, a short grey-streaked full beard, the same olive skin and the same middle age.
Compared Jesus at the tomb (left) with Jesus standing in the boat (right). Both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, a long slim face and the same skin tone.
Compared Peter leaping toward the shore (left) with Peter stepping onto the water (right). Both are middle-aged with dark greying wavy or curly hair, a salt-and-pepper full beard and olive skin.

The crucified figure on the left is tiny on a distant cross, showing only dark hair and a beard. Right Jesus in the boat has long dark-brown hair and a beard, but the left face is too small to compare.
Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with the distant Jesus on the waves (right). Both have long dark-brown hair, a full dark beard and a slim face.

Both show a sandy, rocky dry path through parted teal water under the same gold sky. Left is seen from the shore and right from on the path; the water is drawn darker and flatter on the left but the places do not conflict.

Jesus at the tomb (left, centre) and Jesus standing on the waves (right, far right) both have long dark wavy shoulder-length hair, a full dark beard, similar age and olive skin, in a white tunic with a dark blue-grey mantle.

Moses with the staff at the front of the column (left) and the left figure beside beardless Aaron (right) are both elderly men with long white hair and a long white beard, in a dark brown cloak over a light tunic.
Distant Jesus on the waves (left) and Jesus standing in the boat (right) share long dark hair, a dark full beard, a similar face and build, and a white tunic under a dark blue mantle.

Both are night scenes with green water walls, but the left path runs between a single water wall and tall sandstone cliffs and dunes on its right, while the right path runs between two towering water walls with no cliffs, so the arrangement conflicts.
Icon Jesus at the tomb (left) and Jesus on the water (right, far right) both have dark brown shoulder-length hair, a short dark beard, a cross halo, and a dark blue himation over a pinkish chiton.
Watercolour Jesus at the tomb (left, centre) and Jesus in the boat (right) both have long dark hair, a dark beard, a similar slim build, and a white tunic with a blue-grey mantle.

Daniel on the cliff (left) is an elderly light-skinned man with grey hair and a grey beard, while Daniel in the den (right, centre) has dark brown skin, short black hair and a short trimmed beard and looks younger; skin tone and hair colour conflict.

The crucified figure on the cross (left, top centre) and Jesus at the tomb (right) both show long dark hair, a dark beard, and a halo with a dark blue garment; the face is small on the left but nothing conflicts.
Moses beside Aaron (left) and the staff-bearer leading the column (right, centre) are both elderly with wavy white hair and a full white beard, in a dark brown cloak over an off-white tunic.

Moses at the shore (left, foreground) and the staff-bearer leading the line (right, centre) both have white swept-back hair, a full white beard, an elderly lined face, and a dark brown cloak over a white tunic.

Moses at the head of the path (left) and haloed Moses stretching his arm over the sea (right) are both elderly with white hair and a white beard, in a brown cloak over a light tunic, holding a crook staff.
Moses raising his staff at the shore (left) and Moses standing at the right edge of the path (right) are both elderly with white hair and a full white beard, in a dark brown cloak over a white tunic.
Icon Jesus on the water (left) and the crucified figure (right, top) both have dark brown hair, a dark beard, and a cross halo, with a dark blue himation; the crucified face is small but consistent.
Jesus in the boat (left) and distant Jesus on the waves (right, far right) both have long dark hair, a dark beard and a slim build, in a white tunic with a blue-grey mantle.
Jesus on the waves (left, centre) and Jesus at the tomb (right, centre) both have long dark hair, a dark beard and a similar face, in a white tunic with a blue-grey mantle.

Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with Jesus calling at the tomb (right): both have shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, a full dark beard, the same lean face and age, and a white tunic under a blue-grey cloak.
Compared Peter stepping from the boat (left) with Peter leaping toward shore (right): both have short curly grey hair, a short grey beard, the same weathered middle-aged face and build.

Compared the crucified figure (left, close enough to see the face) with Jesus in the boat (right): both have long dark-brown hair parted in the middle, a full dark beard and the same age, with matching white tunic and blue cloak.
Jesus in the boat (left) is clear, but the crucified figure on the right is a tiny distant figure on the hilltop cross; only dark hair is visible, too small to judge face or beard.
Moses beside Aaron (left) is bald on top with white hair only at the sides and a long chest-length beard; Moses at the sea path (right) has a full head of swept-back white hair and a shorter beard.

Compared Moses at the shore (left) with Moses beside Aaron (right): both are elderly with swept-back shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, a lean lined face and a dark-brown cloak over a light tunic.

Compared Moses beside Aaron (left, frontal) with Moses at the sea (right, profile): both are elderly with white hair and a full white beard, the same skin tone and lean build; the right's hair looks a little longer and wind-blown, but nothing clearly conflicts.

Icon Moses beside Aaron (left) has long white hair flowing past the shoulders and a long chest-length beard; icon Moses at the sea (right) has short grey hair ending at the nape and a short trimmed beard.
Compared icon Jesus in the boat (left) with icon Jesus at the tomb (right): both have centre-parted dark-brown hair falling behind the shoulders, a short dark beard, the same face and a cross-nimbus.

Compared Jesus calling at the tomb (left) with the crucified figure (right, face visible): both have long dark-brown hair, a full dark beard, the same age and face, and a white tunic with a blue-grey cloak.

Peter stepping onto the water (left) has black curly hair, a mostly dark beard and darker skin; Peter leaping from the boat (right) has grey curly hair, a largely grey beard and looks older. The left scene is lit at night, but the hair still reads clearly black.
Compared icon Jesus walking on the water (left) with icon Jesus in the boat (right): both have the same centre-parted dark-brown hair, short dark beard, facial features and cross-nimbus.

Compared Moses beside the column on the sea floor (left) with Moses beside Aaron (right): both are elderly with swept-back white hair to the nape, a full white beard, a lean face with a long nose and a dark-brown cloak.
Jesus walking on the water (right) shows long dark hair and a beard, but the crucified figure on the left is a tiny distant figure with a bowed head, too small to judge his face or beard.

Compared Moses on the sea floor (left, frontal) with Moses at the sea (right, profile): both are elderly with white hair, a full white beard and the same lean build and skin tone; the right's hair looks longer and wind-blown, but nothing clearly conflicts.
